**26 papers in the library run something on LoCoMo.** 23 report LoCoMo results as a main or secondary benchmark, and 3 more use it only partly. I found them by searching every paper's markdown for "LoCoMo" (54 files mention it) and keeping only those that run experiments on it. Papers that only cite it, survey it or list it in a comparison table are left out.

**About the page numbers:** each page comes from the `(p. N)` on the markdown heading the result sits under. A table can float onto the next page in the PDF, so a cited page may be one off.

### Memory systems and methods (`llm/memory/agent/`)

| Paper | Where the LoCoMo results are |
|---|---|
| A-MEM | [p. 6, Table 1](http://pdf.invalid/llm/memory/agent/A-MEM.%20Agentic%20Memory%20for%20LLM%20Agents.pdf?dest=table.1&page=6); setup on p. 5 |
| A-TMA | [p. 11, Tables 3–4](http://pdf.invalid/llm/memory/agent/A-TMA.%20Decoupling%20State-Aware%20Memory%20Failures%20in%20Long-Term%20Agent%20Memory.pdf?dest=subsection.5.3&page=11) (§5.3, all 10 conversations, 1,986 QA pairs, p. 10). It also builds its own benchmark LTP ("LoCoMo Temporal Plus"), p. 5 |

| Choosing How to Remember (FluxMem) | [p. 6, Table 2](http://pdf.invalid/llm/memory/agent/Choosing%20How%20to%20Remember.%20Adaptive%20Memory%20Structures%20for%20LLM%20Agents.pdf?dest=table.2&page=6) and the Table 4 ablation; discussion on p. 7 |

### Benchmarks, safety and personalization papers

| Paper | Where the LoCoMo results are |
|---|---|
| Evaluating Very Long-Term Conversational Memory of LLM Agents (the LoCoMo paper itself) | [p. 6, Tables 2–3](http://pdf.invalid/llm/memory/benchmarks/Evaluating%20Very%20Long-Term%20Conversational%20Memory%20of%20LLM%20Agents.pdf?dest=table.2&page=6) for base, long-context and RAG models; §6.1, p. 7 |
| AgentMemBench | [p. 10](http://pdf.invalid/llm/memory/benchmarks/AgentMemBench.%20A%20Systematic%20Benchmark%20for%20Evaluating%20Long-Term%20Memory%20Management%20Strategies%20in.pdf?page=10) ("Long-range recall is the decisive case (LoCoMo)"); per-dataset numbers in Table 6, p. 12. It uses 200 LoCoMo questions (p. 2) |
| MemGuard | [p. 7, Table 2](http://pdf.invalid/llm/safety-and-privacy/MemGuard.%20Preventing%20Memory%20Contamination%20in%20Long-Term%20Memory-Augmented%20Large%20Language%20Models.pdf?dest=table.2&page=7); error analysis on p. 3 |
| User as Code | [p. 13, Table 1](http://pdf.invalid/llm/personalization/methods/User%20as%20Code.%20Executable%20Memory%20for%20Personalized%20Agents.pdf?dest=table.1&page=13) (full benchmark, 600 QAs); ablations in Tables 9–10, pp. 20–21 |
| OP-Bench | [p. 5, Table 3](http://pdf.invalid/llm/personalization/benchmarks/OP-Bench.%20Benchmarking%20Over-Personalization%20for%20Memory-Augmented%20Personalized%20Conversational%20Agents.pdf?dest=table.3&page=5); extended results in App. C.1, p. 17. OP-Bench itself is built on LoCoMo dialogues (p. 3) |
| Toward Multi-Session Personalized Conversation (ImplexConv / TaciTree) | [p. 7, §6.1–6.2](http://pdf.invalid/llm/personalization/benchmarks/Toward%20Multi-Session%20Personalized%20Conversation.%20A%20Large-Scale%20Dataset%20and%20Hierarchical%20Tree.pdf?page=7); LoCoMo is one of five datasets (p. 6) |

### Partial use
- **When Memory Updates but Behavior Does Not:** uses LoCoMo QA categories 1, 2 and 4 only as an over-correction probe (p. 4). The result is on [p. 7](http://pdf.invalid/llm/personalization/methods/When%20Memory%20Updates%20but%20Behavior%20Does%20Not.%20Repairing%20Implicit%20Stale%20Dependencies%20in%20Personalized.pdf?page=7&search=Over-correction): accuracy falls from .600 to .433 with the gpt-4o-mini auditor.
- **MemSyco-Bench:** runs LoCoMo samples through a memory framework to show that existing benchmarks mostly measure retrieval ([p. 3, Fig. 3](http://pdf.invalid/llm/memory/benchmarks/MemSyco-Bench.%20Benchmarking%20Sycophancy%20in%20Agent%20Memory.pdf?dest=figure.3&page=3); details on p. 29).

### Left out
- **Beyond Recall:** it says explicitly "we do not evaluate memory systems on LoCoMo" (p. 132). It only quotes vendors' published LoCoMo numbers (p. 16).
- **Mentions only:** the surveys (Memory in the Age of AI Agents, Rethinking Memory, and others), the benchmark papers that cite LoCoMo in related work (LongMemEval, MemBench, HaluMem, EvoMemBench, and others), RMM (p. 2), Mem-α (p. 3) and Control-Plane Placement (p. 1).

I didn't change any files.
